# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.2

<!-- update-summary: Recover media observation after missing playback data; reduce progressive lyric UI work; refine Chinese admission and island material, glow and animation. -->

## Changes

- Guard absent Windows playback information and controls. A faulted refresh consumer
  still retires subscriptions and clears stale presentation during reconnect/shutdown.
  Bounded native ownership and generation cancellation remain.
- Reuse progressive lyric rows, compare unchanged cloned records and combine music
  render requests within a UI frame. Publications still scan O(N) lines; this release
  does not claim a proven memory-leak diagnosis or performance benchmark.
- Abstain from uncertain pure-Han self-translation to Chinese without assigning language.
  Retain reliable foreign admission and original/provider lyrics and timings; bind
  plaintext cache identity to admitted physical segments.
- Integrate the accepted bottom-edge/corner simplified glow and bilingual help, early
  transparent-host erase handling, Acrylic geometry coverage, shared physical motion
  geometry, display-aware Rendering scheduling and directional shutter blur.
- Consolidate locale smoke setup and scope encrypted-share worker tests to complete
  related Git changes, while retaining truthful required checks.

## Evidence and accepted omissions

The owner explicitly authorized the final combined Beta.2 while skipping unfinished
extra local acceptance. Existing required GitHub checks and final package/runtime
identity checks still apply. Simplified glow was accepted locally; this does not
establish every subsequent visual or input behavior.

Dynamic half-pixel edges, GPU cost, actual present FPS, integrated blur appearance and
real pointer/OLE input remain unverified. The reported 234–236 Rendering callbacks per
second on a 240 Hz display measure callbacks, not presented frames. Six idle probes
reported no callbacks; they do not qualify every device. Ancestor-collapsed/native-hidden
music rendering and final real-player reconnect behavior also remain unverified. These
are disclosed risks, not passing results.

## Experimental AI limitations

AI remains optional and off by default. The pinned Hy-MT2 1.8B and optional 7B Q8 models,
prompt and 600-second whole-song ceiling are unchanged. Both models remain `unverified`
and `semanticApproved=false`. Historical 300-second failures retain their original
outputs, identities and hashes. Complete 600-second cold/cache, AVX2 and 7B validation
remains unexecuted; host admission calculations do not claim model inference.
Cancellation, cleanup, security and packaging defects are not waived. This exact
experimental-Beta decision grants no Stable release exception.

## Compatibility

Upgrade baseline: v0.3.1-beta.1, retained immutably. Semantic version: `0.3.1-beta.2`;
PE/MSIX version: `0.3.1.2`. This is a prerelease; Stable remains unchanged. The owner will
download and install through the official website; daily App installation is not part
of this operation.
